name: web-server
description: Public SSH, HTTP, HTTPS and HTTP/3; every other inbound TCP and UDP dropped. No egress rule, so egress stays ACCEPT_ALL.

rules.description: SSH; sshd takes keys only and fail2ban bans brute force
HTTP for the ACME challenge and the redirect to HTTPS
NTP replies; the firewall tracks state for TCP only, so UDP replies need their own rule
DNS replies from the nat64.net resolvers that guides/ipv6-only-vps.md sets; netcup's fixed rules pass only its own
Every other inbound TCP; replies to outbound connections pass as established
Every other inbound UDP; DNS from the resolvers of netcup passes their fixed rules first
